module: Node "Set Vehicle Colors" (category `repeat_instant`, tags colors). Changes the three paints of the vehicle: `color1` (main, `obj.color`), `color2` (`colorPalette0`), `color3` (`colorPalette1`). Each `color` pin is a table of 8 numbers: the first 4 = base color (r,g,b,a), the next 4 = metallic data passed to `createVehiclePaint`. Ends with `obj:setMetallicPaintData`. Pin `vehId`: if absent, player vehicle (`be:getPlayerVehicleID(0)`).
notes: Called every frame while the flow is active.
The color is converted to linear (`asLinear4F`) before being applied.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by `_flowgraph_createNode(C)`). Definition fields: name, description, category, pinSchema, tags.

postInit.desc: Marks the three color pins with `colorSetup = {vehicleColor = true}` (vehicle paint picker in the editor).

work.desc: Creates a paint per non-nil color pin, applies it to the vehicle object and sends the list of paints with `setMetallicPaintData`.
